title: Restriction to an over-site preserves epimorphisms of module sheaves
statement: For a Grothendieck site with the stated sheafification hypotheses, if e : A ⟶ B is an epimorphism of sheaves of modules and U is an object of the site, then (overFunctor R U).map e is an epimorphism.

proof.text: An epimorphism of sheaves is locally surjective. Every object of the over-site is a map to U, and pulling back the local covering and local lifts along that map gives local lifts there. The locally-surjective characterization of epimorphisms under WEqualsLocallyBijective therefore proves the restricted morphism epi.

theorem epi_overFunctor_map
    {C : Type v} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}}
    [∀ U, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [∀ U, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    {A B : SheafOfModules.{u} R} (e : A ⟶ B) [Epi e] (U : C) :
    Epi ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor R U).map e)
